title: Research Report Agent
description: Plan, retrieve, verify, synthesize, review, and package an evidence-backed research report with citations, an evidence matrix, a quality scorecard, limitations, and a review checklist.
useWhen: Use when the task is to produce a cited research report: technical deep dive, market or competitive analysis, policy brief, literature review, or an evidence-backed comparison or explainer.
steps: Intake and scope the topic, audience, purpose, constraints, and output format.
Draft the table of contents, research questions, source requirements, and deliverables.
Retrieve authoritative sources and record source notes.
Verify claims against fetched sources and build an evidence matrix.
Draft the report with analysis, tables, and diagrams or examples where useful.
Apply quality scoring and hard-fail publish checks.
Revise until the score and publish gate pass or the blockers are explicit.
Package the report, evidence matrix, scorecard, limitations, references, and review checklist.

verification.title: Cited, verified, packaged
verification.detail: Every major claim is backed by a verified source, limitations are stated, the scorecard passes the publish gate, and the run exports a complete research package.

why: Separating retrieval and verification from synthesis keeps evidence auditable and stops the model from citing unverified or fabricated sources.
